name: review-website
description: CRO, SEO, performance, UI, copy, and competitor review for a public website.
acceptance: The report exists in the conversation language.
Every score has a rationale and every fix has an effort estimate.
The review completes within 20 minutes when no competitors are supplied.

steps.prompt: Confirm the website review goal, audience, language, and what better means.
Crawl the public website and collect page, copy, technology, and analytics evidence.

acceptance: CRO findings cover the home page and top three pages.
SEO, schema, and AI-search findings are recorded.
Performance findings cover the home page and two additional pages.
UI critique covers register, type, color, and spacing.
Hero and CTA copy receives all seven editing sweeps.

steps.prompt: Compare the website with five competitors when competitor URLs are available.
acceptance: Competitor evidence reaches the research depth gate.

steps.prompt: Merge all website findings into out/review.md with a scorecard, prioritized top-ten fixes, effort estimates, copy rewrites, and mockup notes. Apply stop-slop.
acceptance: The report exists in the conversation language.
Every fix has an effort estimate.

steps.prompt: Read the accepted top five fixes back by voice and create tasks.
acceptance: The accepted fixes are represented as tasks.
